name: Quarry of the Endless Toil (CR 10)
body:
This old quarry was a place of misery and death for numerous prisoners and slaves. Even now their spirits are bound to suffer, sharing their weariness with the living who disturb their endless toil.

XP 9,600; NE haunt (an open pit, 30 feet wide and 50 feet long at the top, with 5-foot-high terraces and a few ramps leading upwards); Caster Level 10th; Notice Perception DC 24 (to hear quiet ringing of picks on the stone); hp 20; Trigger proximity (entering the lowest level of the pit); Reset 1 hour

EFFECT

When the lowest level of the pit is reached, a wave of exhaustion spreads through the quarry.

DESTRUCTION

The quarry must be covered with a blanket of dirt and sand until no stone is exposed to the air.
